evidence.actual: The authorization code has already been redeemed.
evidence.note: The code was exchanged twice. React StrictMode runs effects twice in development, which fits the intermittent failures.
This exactly matches a registered URI, so redirect_uri is not the cause.
The PKCE verifier matches the challenge, so PKCE is not the cause.

output.fix: Make sure the callback exchanges the authorization code exactly once. In React, don't run the token exchange directly in a useEffect that StrictMode double-invokes. Use a module-level or useRef "already started" guard, or store the in-flight exchange promise keyed by the code and reuse it. Remove the code and state from the URL once the exchange starts, for example with history.replaceState. Don't retry a failed exchange with the same code. If it fails, start a new authorization request. Keep PKCE S256 and the exact redirect_uri on that single exchange. StrictMode double-invocation happens only in development, so check production builds separately, since a retry or a second tab could cause the same error there.
